cards.titleEn: End-to-End Integrated Prediction and Multi-period Portfolio Optimization
keyPoints: IPMO将多期收益预测与带换手惩罚的均值-方差优化整合为端到端可微管道，由组合业绩驱动预测器学习。
针对可扩展性，提出镜像下降不动点（MDFP）微分方案，避免分解KKT系统，获得稳定隐式梯度。
MDFP使运行时随决策期数增长近乎不敏感，缓解多期优化计算负担。
在真实市场数据与两个代表性时间序列预测模型上，IPMO在扣除交易成本后的风险调整表现上持续优于两阶段基准。
实验报告IPMO产生更连贯的配置路径，体现多期决策的时序一致性。
cards.limitationsEn: The paper abstract reports experiments only on real market data with two representative time-series prediction models and does not provide specific datasets, market scope, transaction cost parameters, risk aversion coefficients, maximum decision horizon, or statistical significance tests. Therefore, external validity, strategy capacity, and performance under extreme market conditions cannot be judged from the abstract. The stability and runtime advantages of MDFP are mainly based on the authors' experiments, with no systematic comparison to other implicit differentiation or unrolling methods. The turnover penalty form and differentiable convex optimization layer settings may affect results, and the abstract does not discuss hyperparameter sensitivity. Results do not constitute investment advice.
cards.description: 该研究提出IPMO，将多期收益预测与带换手惩罚的均值-方差组合优化整合为可微分层，用组合业绩驱动预测器学习，避免两阶段方法的预测与决策错配。为提升可扩展性，引入镜像下降不动点微分方案，无需分解KKT系统即可获得稳定隐式梯度，且运行时间随决策期数增长近乎不敏感。在真实市场数据与两个代表性时间序列预测模型上，IPMO在扣除交易成本后的风险调整收益上持续优于两阶段基准，并给出更连贯的配置路径。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Multi-period portfolio management must account for transaction costs, path-dependent risks, and the intertemporal structure of decisions. Classical two-stage methods first predict then optimize, which can misalign prediction objectives with final investment outcomes and ignore transaction cost effects. IPMO attempts to narrow this misalignment via end-to-end learning, improving risk-adjusted performance net of transaction costs while keeping multi-period scaling computationally feasible through MDFP. For quantitative research, it offers a modeling paradigm that aligns prediction learning with portfolio decision objectives, but its robustness still needs testing across more markets, cost settings, and model specifications.
cards.originalTitle: Integrated Prediction and Multi-period Portfolio Optimization
keyPointsEn: IPMO integrates multi-period return prediction with turnover-penalized mean-variance optimization into an end-to-end differentiable pipeline, where portfolio performance drives predictor learning.
For scalability, it introduces a mirror-descent fixed-point (MDFP) differentiation scheme that avoids factorizing KKT systems and yields stable implicit gradients.
MDFP makes runtime nearly scale-insensitive as the decision horizon grows, alleviating the computational burden of multi-period optimization.
On real market data with two representative time-series prediction models, IPMO consistently outperforms two-stage benchmarks in risk-adjusted performance net of transaction costs.
Experiments report that IPMO produces more coherent allocation paths, reflecting intertemporal consistency in multi-period decisions.
cards.whyItMatters: 多期组合管理需同时处理交易成本、路径依赖风险与跨期决策结构，传统两阶段方法先预测再优化，易造成预测目标与最终投资结果错配，并忽略交易成本影响。IPMO尝试用端到端学习缩小这一错配，在扣除交易成本的风险调整指标上改善表现，同时通过MDFP保持多期扩展下的计算可行性。对量化研究而言，它提供了一个将预测学习与组合决策目标对齐的建模范式，但仍需在更多市场、成本和模型设定下检验其稳健性。
cards.title: 多期投资组合的端到端预测与优化一体化框架
cards.summary: 事实：论文针对多期组合优化中经典两阶段框架的错配问题，提出IPMO，将多期收益预测器与可微凸优化层连接，以组合表现为学习信号，并设计镜像下降不动点（MDFP）微分方案以规避KKT系统分解，实现稳定隐式梯度与近乎规模不敏感的运行时。实验使用真实市场数据和两个时间序列预测模型，报告在扣除交易成本后的风险调整表现上优于两阶段基准，且配置路径更连贯。作者观点：作者认为端到端整合预测与优化在多期设定下能改善财务结果并保持计算可行。
cards.limitations: 论文摘要仅报告了使用真实市场数据与两个代表性时间序列预测模型的实验结果，未提供具体数据集、市场范围、交易成本参数、风险厌恶系数、决策期数上限或统计显著性检验细节，因此外部有效性、策略容量与极端市场条件下的表现无法从摘要判断。MDFP的稳定性与运行时优势主要基于作者实验，未说明与其它隐式微分或展开方法的系统对比。换手惩罚形式与可微凸优化层的设定可能对结果有影响，摘要未讨论超参数敏感性。结果不构成投资建议。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes IPMO, which integrates multi-period return prediction with turnover-penalized mean-variance portfolio optimization into a differentiable layer, using portfolio performance to drive predictor learning and avoid the prediction-decision misalignment of two-stage methods. For scalability, it introduces a mirror-descent fixed-point differentiation scheme that avoids factorizing KKT systems, yielding stable implicit gradients and nearly scale-insensitive runtime
cards.summaryEn: Facts: The paper addresses the misalignment in the classical two-stage framework for multi-period portfolio optimization and proposes IPMO, which connects a multi-period return predictor to a differentiable convex optimization layer, uses portfolio performance as the learning signal, and designs a mirror-descent fixed-point (MDFP) differentiation scheme to avoid KKT system factorization, achieving stable implicit gradients and nearly scale-insensitive runtime. Experiments use real market data and two time-series prediction models, reporting better risk-adjusted performance net of transaction costs than two-stage benchmarks and more coherent allocation paths. Authors' view: The authors argue that integrating prediction and optimization end-to-end in the multi-period setting improves financial outcomes while remaining computationally tractable.

cards.titleEn: Screening-Off Information and Conditional Risk in Portfolio Choice
keyPoints: 将条件投资组合模型中信息集是否移除共同依赖的问题形式化为“筛选掉”。
建立因果、分布与二阶矩要求的层级，并用精确协方差分解区分三类成分。
两个表示误差影响不同：省略响应必然高估均值-方差机会，不完全筛选可双向扭曲。
提供有限扰动恒等式和非渐近界，连接表示失败与约束组合权重及前沿潜力变化。
受控实验在静态、重尾、动态和非线性设计下验证机制。
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on specific controlled experiments and frozen out-of-sample market tests using 150 U.S. equities and 17 hedge-fund strategy indices, with limited sample scope and periods. Non-asymptotic bounds and perturbation identities hold under theoretical settings, while real-world driver selection, model specification, and parameter uncertainty may affect conclusions. Compact representations reduce residual dependence in tests, but it is not proven that they outperform established covariance regularizers across all markets, asset classes, or regimes. The framework is a diagnostic tool for information screening, not investment advice, and does not assert direct enhancement of actual investment returns.
cards.description: 该研究提出“筛选掉”概念，用以检验条件投资组合模型所选信息集是否消除了资产间共同依赖。新意在于将表示误差分解为被省略响应风险与残留跨资产依赖，并给出有限样本扰动恒等式与非渐近界，把表示失误映射到约束组合权重与前沿潜力的变化。研究表明两个表示误差对可达到均值-方差机会的影响方向不同，从而提供可证伪的信息准则和从表示失败到组合不稳定的直接路径。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research provides a falsifiable information screening criterion for conditional risk modeling, helping identify cases where systematic risk is misclassified as idiosyncratic because the information set fails to remove common dependence. Its decomposition and error bounds directly assess how representation failure distorts portfolio weights and efficient frontiers, offering diagnostic value for quantitative portfolio construction, risk estimation, and covariance regularization practice.
cards.originalTitle: Screening-Off Information and Conditional Risk in Portfolio Choice
keyPointsEn: Formalizes as screening-off the question of whether the information set in conditional portfolio models removes common dependence.
Establishes a hierarchy of causal, distributional, and second-moment requirements, with an exact covariance decomposition distinguishing three components.
The two representation errors differ: omitted response necessarily overstates mean-variance opportunities, while incomplete screening can distort them in either direction.
Provides finite perturbation identities and non-asymptotic bounds linking representation failure to changes in constrained portfolio weights and frontier potential.
Controlled experiments verify mechanisms under static, heavy-tailed, dynamic, and nonlinear designs.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为条件风险建模提供了可证伪的信息筛选准则，有助于识别因信息集未能移除共同依赖而将系统性风险误判为特异性风险的情形。其分解与误差界可直接评估表示失败对组合权重和有效前沿的扭曲，对量化组合构建、风险估计和协方差正则化实践具有诊断价值。
cards.title: 投资组合选择中的信息筛选与条件风险
cards.summary: 条件投资组合模型通常相对于选定信息集估计风险，但很少检验该信息是否移除了资产间共同依赖。若未移除，系统性风险可能被当作特异性风险，扭曲组合和可达到的有效前沿。作者将此先验问题表述为投资组合选择中的筛选掉，建立区分因果、分布与二阶矩要求的层级，并用精确协方差分解区分已表示的系统性响应、被省略的响应风险和残留的跨资产依赖。两个表示误差具有不同的金融含义：被省略的响应必然高估可达到的均值-方差机会，而不完全筛选可能朝任一方向扭曲它们。精确有限扰动恒等式和非渐近界将两种误差映射到约束组合权重和前沿潜力的变化。受控实验在静态、重尾、动态和非线性设计中验证了机制。冻结的样本外市场测试结合广泛可观测经济与金融驱动因素、150只美国股票和17个对冲基金策略指数。紧凑的所选表示在两个面板中均实质性降低残留依赖；在股票中，考虑残留的协方差估计显著优于未校正的对角残留限制，同时与既有协方差正则化方法保持竞争力。框架提供了条件风险的可证伪信息准则，以及从表示失败到投资组合不稳定的直接映射。作者观点：该框架应作为信息筛选的诊断工具，而非直接的投资策略建议。
cards.limitations: 研究基于特定受控实验与冻结样本外市场测试，使用150只美国股票和17个对冲基金策略指数，样本范围和时期有限。非渐近界与扰动恒等式在理论设定下成立，实际市场中的驱动因素选择、模型设定和参数不确定性可能影响结论。紧凑表示在测试中降低残留依赖，但未证明在所有市场、资产类别或制度下均优于既有协方差正则化方法。该框架是信息筛选诊断工具，不构成投资建议，也未断言可直接提升实际投资收益。

cards.summaryEn: Conditional portfolio models typically estimate risk relative to a chosen information set, but rarely test whether that information removes common cross-asset dependence. When it does not, systematic risk may be treated as idiosyncratic, distorting portfolios and attainable efficient frontiers. The author formulates this prior problem as screening-off for portfolio choice, establishes a hierarchy separating causal, distributional, and second-moment requirements, and uses an exact covariance decomposition to distinguish represented systematic response, omitted response risk, and residual cross-asset dependence. The two representation errors have different financial implications: omitted response necessarily overstates attainable mean-variance opportunities, whereas incomplete screening can distort them in either direction. Exact finite perturbation identities and non-asymptotic bounds map both errors into changes in constrained portfolio weights and frontier potential. Controlled experiments verify the mechanisms under static, heavy-tailed, dynamic, and nonlinear designs. Frozen out-of-sample market tests combine a broad universe of observable economic and financial drivers with 150 U.S. equities and 17 hedge-fund strategy indices. Compact selected representations materially reduce residual dependence in both panels; in equities, residual-aware covariance estimation improves materially on the uncorrected diagonal-residual restriction while remaining competitive with established covariance regularizers. The framework provides a falsifiable information criterion for conditional risk and a direct map from representation failure to portfolio instability. Author's view: the framework should serve as a diagnostic tool for information screening, not as direct investment strategy advice.

cards.titleEn: MAVEN-T: Reinforced Heterogeneous Distillation for Real-Time Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction
keyPoints: 提出 MAVEN-T：面向实时多智能体轨迹预测的强化异构蒸馏框架
教师模型：环绕感知图编码器 + 时间滤波 + 移位窗口空间注意力 + 稀疏 MoE 解码头
学生模型：紧凑 GRU-Squeeze-and-Excitation + 低秩适配策略头
三级蒸馏：特征级、注意力级、语义级
强化精调：PPO 奖励关注避碰、舒适、通行
cards.limitationsEn: Based on the abstract, specific accuracy numbers per dataset, ablation details, and statistical significance are not provided; reported results are limited to specified hardware and datasets, with no evidence on cross-platform, cross-sensor, or real-world long-tail transfer; the safety alignment effect may depend on reward design and weighting, but no sensitivity analysis is disclosed; the 14.6 ms latency and compression ratio are self-reported and require independent replication.
cards.description: 论文提出 MAVEN-T，用强化学习驱动的异构知识蒸馏，将高容量教师模型压缩为轻量学生模型，在保持精度的同时实现实时多智能体轨迹预测；其新意在于用 PPO 奖励直接对齐避碰、舒适与通行等下游目标，而非静态模仿。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible, the approach offers a path for on-board real-time trajectory prediction that compresses parameters and accelerates inference while aligning predictions with downstream objectives like collision avoidance, comfort, and progress via reinforcement learning, potentially reducing deployment costs of high-capacity models and improving closed-loop safety.
cards.originalTitle: MAVEN-T: Reinforced Heterogeneous Distillation for Real-Time Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction
keyPointsEn: Proposes MAVEN-T: a reinforced heterogeneous distillation framework for real-time multi-agent trajectory prediction
Teacher: surround-aware graph encoder + temporal filtering + shifted-window spatial attention + sparse MoE decoding head
Student: compact GRU-Squeeze-and-Excitation with a Low-Rank Adapted policy head
Three-level distillation: feature, attention, and semantic levels
Reinforcement refinement: PPO rewards for collision avoidance, comfort, and progress
cards.whyItMatters: 若结果可复现，该方法为车载端实时轨迹预测提供了一条在压缩参数与加速推理的同时，通过强化学习将预测对齐到避碰、舒适与通行等下游目标的路径，有助于降低高容量模型部署成本并提升闭环安全性。
cards.title: 面向实时多智能体轨迹预测的强化异构蒸馏框架
cards.summary: 事实：论文针对自动驾驶轨迹预测中密集交互、行为异构、多模态未来和车载算力有限的问题，提出 MAVEN-T 框架。教师模型使用环绕感知图编码器建模有向局部交互，结合高效时间滤波与移位窗口空间注意力，并通过稀疏混合专家头解码特定机动未来。学生模型是带低秩适配策略头的紧凑 GRU-Squeeze-and-Excitation 网络，通过特征、注意力和语义三级蒸馏训练，再用近端策略优化奖励（避碰、舒适、通行）精调，并以复杂度感知课程和弹性权重巩固稳定分阶段训练。实验在 NGSIM、HighD、MoCAD、Argoverse 2 和 Waymo Open Motion 数据集上评估精度、效率、泛化、鲁棒性和闭环安全，报告学生模型实现 6.2 倍参数压缩、3.7 倍推理加速，在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上延迟 14.6 毫秒，同时保持有竞争力的精度。作者观点：轻量预测器和常规蒸馏通常依赖静态模仿，未显式纠正安全相关的教师偏差，故需引入强化精调。
cards.limitations: 论文信息来自摘要，未给出各数据集上的具体精度数值、消融实验细节与统计显著性；报告结果仅在指定硬件与数据集上获得，未说明跨平台、跨传感器配置或真实道路长尾场景的迁移表现；强化奖励设计与权重可能影响安全对齐效果，但摘要未披露敏感性分析；14.6 毫秒延迟与压缩倍数为作者自报，需独立复现验证。
cards.descriptionEn: The paper proposes MAVEN-T, a reinforcement-driven heterogeneous knowledge distillation framework that compresses a high-capacity teacher into a lightweight student for real-time multi-agent trajectory prediction; its novelty lies in aligning predictions with downstream objectives such as collision avoidance, comfort, and progress via PPO rewards rather than static imitation.
cards.summaryEn: Facts: The paper addresses dense interactions, heterogeneous behaviors, multimodal futures, and limited on-board computation in autonomous driving trajectory prediction by proposing MAVEN-T. The teacher uses a surround-aware graph encoder for directed local interactions, efficient temporal filtering with shifted-window spatial attention, and a sparse Mixture-of-Experts head for maneuver-specific futures. The student is a compact GRU-Squeeze-and-Excitation network with a Low-Rank Adapted policy head, trained via feature-, attention-, and semantic-level distillation, then refined with Proximal Policy Optimization rewards for collision avoidance, comfort, and progress, stabilized by a complexity-aware curriculum and Elastic Weight Consolidation. Experiments on NGSIM, HighD, MoCAD, Argoverse 2, and Waymo Open Motion evaluate accuracy, efficiency, generalization, robustness, and closed-loop safety; the student reports 6.2x parameter compression, 3.7x inference acceleration, and 14.6 ms latency on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin while maintaining competitive accuracy. Authors' view: lightweight predictors and conventional distillation rely on static imitation and do not explicitly correct safety-relevant teacher bias, motivating reinforcement refinement.

cards.whyItMattersEn: If the framework and empirical findings hold, they offer a way to infer collective decision mechanisms from observable market behavior and potentially cross-check brain-mechanism hypotheses, while also proposing an AGI design path different from simply scaling ANN parameter counts: introducing adaptive, entangled game modules and brain-inspired simulations. For quantitative research, the value lies in decomposing trading decision patterns into entangled game eigenmodes and components that adjust to news and environments, providing a new modeling language for collective market behavior; for AGI, the authors suggest this may lead to more compact, efficient, and robust system designs.
cards.originalTitle: Adaptive Entangled Game Modules in Artificial General Intelligence
keyPointsEn: Introduces a generalized behavioral intelligence (GBI) nonlocal probability-wave equation to model the collective behavior of interacting adaptive agents and derive testable eigenmodes.

Using Chinese intraday stock market data, the authors report that adaptive entangled game modes explain 82–94% (89% overall) of decision patterns, while purely independent rational-agent modes account for less than 5%.
About 2–12% of behaviors are described as adapting to intraday news, events, and environments, with dual equilibrium states and abrupt reference-point shifts.

The authors state that these results sharply contrast with neoclassical finance predictions based on independent rational agents and are used as an indirect way to examine the LCA hypothesis of nonlocal entangled nerve fibers.
The paper argues for incorporating adaptive entangled game modules into AGI architectures to address the limitations of conventional ANN-based AI that relies on trillions of opaque parameters.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该框架与实证结论成立，它提供了一种从可观测市场行为反推集体决策机制、并可能与脑机制假设相互印证的路径，同时也为AGI架构提出不同于单纯扩大ANN参数规模的思路：引入自适应、纠缠式博弈模块与脑启发模拟。对量化研究而言，其意义在于把交易决策模式分解为纠缠博弈本征模与随新闻环境调整的成分，为理解市场集体行为提供新的建模语言；对AGI而言，作者认为这可能带来更紧凑、高效、稳健的系统设计方向。

cards.whyItMattersEn: CVA is a regulatory-capital-related quantity that financial institutions must compute, typically relying on costly Monte Carlo simulation. This study tests whether the coherent amplification advantage of quantum amplitude estimation survives realistic financial encoding and noisy hardware, and provides an error decomposition. It offers a noise-aware methodological framework for moving quantum finance from theoretical advantage toward reproducible hardware experiments.

Its core CABIQAE incorporates experimentally calibrated Grover-contrast loss into Bayesian inference and circuit-depth selection. The novelty lies in embedding hardware-noise awareness into iterative amplitude estimation decisions rather than post-hoc correction. It is useful because it shows that limited coherent amplification on current noisy devices can be exploited more effectiv
cards.summaryEn: Fact: CVA requires repeated risk-neutral expectation estimation, making it a natural test bed for quantum amplitude estimation. The authors develop an end-to-end noise-aware quantum workflow covering market calibration, discretisation, oracle construction, hardware execution, and error-budget analysis. The model combines correlated two-asset exposure with discount and default factors, encoded through a QCBM-based joint time-market distribution and controlled payoff rotations. They introduce CABIQAE, which incorporates experimentally calibrated Grover-contrast loss into Bayesian inference and circuit-depth selection. Hardware-calibrated experiments show that CABIQAE exploits the limited amplification available on current devices more effectively than noise-agnostic alternatives and achieves much lower classical post-processing runtime than the noise-aware BAE baseline. The analysis decomposes total CVA error into statistical, encoding, discretisation, and hardware contributions. Author view: the full CVA oracle remains limited by circuit depth and discretisation resolution.

cards.titleEn: Evidence That Feature Engineering Outperforms Deep Learning in Investor Flow Prediction
keyPoints: 研究比较了简约线性特征工程与ICA、小波相干和注意力LSTM等复杂方法。
数据覆盖2020至2024年2,439只韩国股票，共279万条观察。
市值标准化资金流的简约线性模型夏普比率为1.30，累计收益272.6%。
完整ICA-小波-LSTM流程夏普比率仅0.07，累计收益-5.1%。
原始LSTM退化为预测无条件均值，命中率47.5%，低于随机水平。
cards.limitationsEn: The results are based on 2.79 million order flow observations from the Korean stock market during 2020-2024 and cannot be directly extrapolated to other markets, asset classes, or periods. The backtested Sharpe ratios and cumulative returns do not specify whether transaction costs, slippage, out-of-sample testing, or robustness controls are included, so they should not be treated as investable performance. The study compares only specific configurations of ICA, wavelet coherence, and LSTM, not all possible deep learning or feature engineering approaches; the conclusion should be understood as an empirical finding under the stated conditions rather than a universal rule.
cards.description: 该研究基于韩国股市279万条样本，比较了ICA、小波相干与LSTM等复杂方法与简单标准化资金流的预测表现，发现简单线性模型在夏普比率和累计收益上大幅领先，提示低信噪比金融预测中领域特征工程可能比算法复杂度更有价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study provides boundary-condition evidence for the question of whether increasing model complexity always improves financial prediction. If simple, domain-informed feature engineering indeed outperforms deep models in low signal-to-noise settings, quantitative research resource allocation and model selection may need to emphasize data representation and preprocessing rather than algorithmic complexity alone.
cards.originalTitle: The Limits of Complexity: Why Feature Engineering Beats Deep Learning in Investor Flow Prediction
keyPointsEn: The study compares parsimonious linear feature engineering with ICA, wavelet coherence, and attention-based LSTM methods.
The dataset covers 2,439 Korean equities from 2020 to 2024, totaling 2.79 million observations.
A simple linear model using market-capitalization-normalized flows achieves a Sharpe ratio of 1.30 and cumulative return of 272.6%.
The full ICA-wavelet-LSTM pipeline achieves a Sharpe ratio of only 0.07 and cumulative return of -5.1%.
The raw LSTM collapses to predicting the unconditional mean with a 47.5% hit rate, worse than random.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为金融机器学习中“增加模型复杂度是否总能提升预测”的问题提供了边界条件证据。若在低信噪比场景下简单且符合领域逻辑的特征工程确实优于深层模型，则量化研究资源配置和模型选择标准可能需要更重视数据表示与预处理，而非单纯追求算法复杂度。
cards.title: 投资者资金流预测中特征工程优于深度学习的证据
cards.summary: 作者使用2020至2024年间2,439只韩国股票共279万条观察数据，检验独立成分分析、小波相干分析和带注意力机制的LSTM能否从投资者订单流中提取超出简单特征工程的预测信息。结果表明，经过市值标准化处理的简约线性模型取得夏普比率1.30和272.6%累计收益；完整ICA-小波-LSTM流程仅取得夏普比率0.07和-5.1%累计收益，原始LSTM退化为预测无条件均值，命中率47.5%。作者据此认为，在低信噪比金融环境中，领域特定特征工程的边际收益显著高于算法复杂度。上述业绩数字为样本内或特定回测结果，属于作者基于特定数据集和方法的结论。
cards.limitations: 结果基于2020至2024年韩国股票市场的279万条订单流观察，不能直接外推到其他市场、资产类别或时期。回测中的夏普比率和累计收益未说明是否包含交易成本、滑点、样本外检验或稳健性控制，因此不能视为可投资业绩。研究只比较了特定ICA、小波相干和LSTM配置，未穷尽所有深度学习或特征工程方案，结论应理解为在所设条件下的经验发现，而非普遍规律。
cards.descriptionEn: Using 2.79 million observations from Korean equities, this study compares ICA, wavelet coherence, and LSTM against simple normalized flow features, finding that a parsimonious linear model substantially outperforms complex pipelines and suggesting domain-specific feature engineering may matter more than algorithmic complexity in low signal-to-noise financial prediction.
cards.summaryEn: The author examines whether independent component analysis, wavelet coherence analysis, and attention-based LSTM networks can extract predictive value from investor order flows beyond simple feature engineering, using 2.79 million observations across 2,439 Korean equities from 2020 to 2024. A parsimonious linear model using market-capitalization-normalized flows achieves a Sharpe ratio of 1.30 and cumulative return of 272.6%, while the full ICA-wavelet-LSTM pipeline achieves only a Sharpe ratio of 0.07 and cumulative return of -5.1%; the raw LSTM collapses to predicting the unconditional mean with a 47.5% hit rate. The author concludes that in low signal-to-noise financial environments, domain-specific feature engineering yields substantially higher marginal returns than algorithmic complexity. These performance figures are backtest results from a specific dataset and methodology.

cards.titleEn: Textual Descriptors Alone Can Predict Startup Exit
keyPoints: 数据覆盖20年、7419家初创企业，来自风投整理的数据集。
研究隔离文本框架变量，工程化850个特征，不依赖上下文、财务或人力资本变量。
对数据子集与向量嵌入进行统计显著性评估，并比较六种监督机器学习模型。
LightGBM取得最高预测性能，F1=0.48；仅文本描述时F1=0.30。
优化密度的炒作标记（形容词、行话、流行词）与更高退出概率相关，过长的陈述或名称则降低退出概率。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries include: it relies solely on a venture capital-curated dataset and may suffer from selection bias; the Exit definition and labeling depend on the dataset itself, with no stated distinction of Exit types or time windows; the absolute F1 values of 0.48 and 0.30 are limited, indicating that textual signals alone still have weak predictive power; the association between hyping markers and Exit probability is not causal; the practical effectiveness of the Hyping Score requires independent samples and prospective validation; feature engineering and model selection may affect the robustness of results.
cards.description: 该研究用20年7419家初创企业的风投数据集，从创始人叙事文本中工程化850个特征，在仅使用文本描述、不依赖财务或人力资本变量的条件下预测早期初创企业是否退出。其新处在于分离出纯文本框架变量，并给出可量化的炒作评分；有用性在于为高信息不对称下的风险投资筛选提供可测量的文本信号。
cards.whyItMattersEn: In early-stage investing under high information asymmetry, financial and human capital information is often scarce. This study suggests that founder narrative text itself may contain measurable signals for predicting Exit and offers the Hyping Score as an actionable metric, providing a new feature perspective for venture capital screening and text-driven quantitative research.
cards.originalTitle: Predicting Startup Exit from Textual Descriptors - A Computational Linguistics Framework
keyPointsEn: The dataset covers 7,419 startups over 20 years and is venture capital-curated.
The study isolates text-based framing variables, engineers 850 features, and does not rely on contextual, financial, or human capital variables.
It evaluates data subsets and vector embeddings for statistical significance and compares six supervised machine learning models.
LightGBM achieved the highest predictive performance (F1 = 0.48); textual descriptors alone achieved F1 = 0.30.
Optimized densities of hyping markers (adjectives, jargon, buzzwords) are associated with higher Exit probability, whereas excessive statement or name length reduces it.
cards.whyItMatters: 在高信息不对称的早期投资中，财务与人力资本信息往往稀缺。该研究表明创始人叙事文本本身可能包含可测量的退出预测信号，并给出炒作评分这一可操作指标，为风投筛选和文本驱动的量化研究提供了新的特征视角。
cards.title: 文本描述可独立预测初创企业退出
cards.summary: 研究基于风投整理的20年7419家初创企业数据集，将文本框架变量单独分离，通过初创叙事映射工程化850个特征。作者对数据子集和向量嵌入进行统计显著性评估，随后开展六种监督机器学习实验。事实性结果是：LightGBM取得最高预测表现（F1=0.48），仅使用文本描述时F1=0.30；特征分析显示形容词、行话和流行词等炒作标记的最优密度与更高退出概率相关，而过长的陈述或名称会降低退出概率。作者据此认为创始人叙事具有独立预测价值，并提出可用于风投场景的可量化炒作评分。需要区分的是，炒作评分与文本信号的实用价值属于作者观点，其预测能力仍受F1绝对值较低的限制。
cards.limitations: 证据边界包括：仅基于风投整理的数据集，可能存在选择偏差；退出定义与标注依赖数据集本身，未说明是否区分退出类型或时间窗口；F1=0.48与0.30的绝对水平有限，说明文本信号单独预测能力仍较弱；炒作标记与退出概率的相关性不等于因果关系；炒作评分的实际应用效果需独立样本与前瞻性验证；特征工程与模型选择可能影响结果稳健性。
cards.descriptionEn: Using a 20-year venture capital-curated dataset of 7,419 startups, this study engineers 850 features from founder narratives and predicts early-stage startup Exit using textual descriptors alone, without contextual, financial, or human capital variables. Its novelty lies in isolating text-based framing variables and introducing a quantifiable Hyping Score; its usefulness is in offering measurable textual signals for venture capital screening under high information asymmetry.
cards.summaryEn: The study uses a venture capital-curated dataset covering 7,419 startups over 20 years, isolates text-based framing variables, and engineers 850 features through startup narrative mapping. The authors evaluate data subsets and vector embeddings for statistical significance, then conduct supervised machine learning experiments across six models. Factual results: LightGBM achieved the highest predictive performance (F1 = 0.48), while textual descriptors alone achieved F1 = 0.30; feature analysis shows that optimized densities of hyping markers such as adjectives, jargon, and buzzwords are associated with higher Exit probability, whereas excessive statement or name length reduces it. The authors accordingly argue that founder narratives have standalone predictive value and propose a quantifiable Hyping Score for venture capital applications. It should be distinguished that the practical value of the Hyping Score and textual signals is the authors' view, and predictive power remains limited by the low absolute F1 values.

cards.titleEn: Pricing Stock Perpetual Futures: Evidence from the SpaceX Pre-IPO Market
keyPoints: 单一无套利框架统一了 Shiller 永续期货与加密永续合约设计：永续价格是基准流按资金费率折现的现值，资金规则同时决定基准与折现。
随机时间变换表示：永续价格等于时钟首次事件时的预期现货价，时钟强度为资金费率。
随机波动率仅通过 carry 影响基差，波动率风险溢价而非波动率本身可以打破锚定。
价格发现被解读为由随机逼近驱动的 Doob 鞅收敛。
分割市场均衡使上市前溢价具有结构性而非行为性。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries include: the no-arbitrage result and random time change representation are theoretical derivations whose assumptions (e.g., frictionless markets, specific funding rules) require further testing for real-world applicability; the SpaceX case is only one pre-IPO market with a limited sample, so extrapolation to other equities or markets should be cautious; the interpretations of price discovery and segmented market equilibrium reflect the authors' theoretical perspective and are not a consensus among all market participants; no specific numerical values, statistical significance, sample period details, or transaction cost effects are provided, so practical implementability and robustness cannot be assessed; this does not constitute investment advice.
cards.description: 该研究将 Shiller 1993 年提出的永续期货概念统一为单一无套利框架，该框架同时涵盖 Shiller 原始设计与加密市场版本：永续价格等于基准流按资金费率折现的现值，因此资金规则同时决定了基准与折现率。作者用随机时间变换表示价格，并证明随机波动率仅通过 carry 影响基差，波动率风险溢价而非波动率本身可导致脱锚。2026 年 6 月 SpaceX 上市前市场是该理念在股权上的首次大规模实现，研究发现永续合约共识比簿记报价更准确地预测了二级清算价格。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study provides a unified no-arbitrage pricing framework for stock perpetual futures, linking Shiller's original design with crypto market practice and testing its predictive power for the first time in a large pre-IPO equity market (SpaceX). If the perpetual consensus is indeed more accurate than the bookbuilt offer, it may affect price discovery in pre-IPO equity, derivative design, and information efficiency in private company valuation.
cards.originalTitle: Perpetual Futures for Stocks: The SpaceX Pre-IPO Market
keyPointsEn: A single no-arbitrage framework unifies Shiller's perpetual futures and crypto perpetual designs: the perpetual price is the present value of a benchmark flow discounted at the funding rate, so the funding rule determines both the benchmark and the discount.
Random time change representation: the perpetual price equals the expected spot at the first event of a clock whose intensity is the funding rate.
Stochastic volatility moves the basis only through carry, so a volatility risk premium and not volatility itself can break the peg.
Price discovery is interpreted as the convergence of a Doob martingale driven by a stochastic approximation.
A segmented market equilibrium makes the pre-listing premium structural rather than behavioral.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为股票永续期货提供了统一的无套利定价框架，将 Shiller 的原始设计与加密市场实践联系起来，并首次在大型股权上市前市场（SpaceX）中检验其预测能力。若永续共识确实比簿记报价更准确，则可能影响上市前股权价格发现、衍生品设计以及私人公司估值的信息效率。
cards.title: 股票永续期货定价：SpaceX 上市前市场的实证
cards.summary: Robert Shiller 于 1993 年提出永续期货，旨在为流动性差或价格无法直接观测的资产（如单户住宅、人力资本和消费者价格指数）创建衍生品市场。加密市场后来出于不同原因、使用不同资金规则构建了该工具。本文给出一个单一无套利结果，将两种设计纳入同一框架：永续价格是基准流按资金费率折现的现值，因此资金规则同时选择基准和折现。作者提供随机时间变换表示，其中价格是时钟首次事件时的预期现货价，时钟强度为资金费率；并据此说明随机波动率仅通过 carry 影响基差，因此波动率风险溢价而非波动率本身可以打破锚定。作者将价格发现解读为由随机逼近驱动的 Doob 鞅收敛，并给出分割市场均衡，使上市前溢价具有结构性而非行为性。2026 年 6 月 SpaceX 上市前市场是这一理念在股权索取权上的首次大规模实现；作者发现永续共识比簿记报价更准确地预测二级清算价格。事实部分包括无套利结果、随机时间变换表示、随机波动率通过 carry 影响基差、分割市场均衡以及 SpaceX 市场的预测比较结果。作者观点部分包括将上市前溢价解释为结构性而非行为性，以及将价格发现解读为 Doob 鞅收敛。
cards.limitations: 证据边界包括：无套利结果和随机时间变换表示属于理论推导，其假设（如无摩擦、特定资金规则）在真实市场中的适用性需进一步检验；SpaceX 案例仅为一个上市前市场，样本有限，结论外推至其他股权或市场需谨慎；价格发现和分割市场均衡的解释包含作者的理论视角，并非所有市场参与者共识；文中未提供具体数值、统计显著性、样本期细节或交易成本影响，因此无法评估实际可操作性和稳健性；不构成投资建议。

The authors provide a random time change representation and show that stochastic volatility moves the basis only through carry, so a volatility risk premium, not volatility itself
cards.summaryEn: Robert Shiller proposed perpetual futures in 1993 to create derivative markets for assets that are illiquid or whose price cannot be observed directly, such as single-family homes, human capital, and the consumer price index. Crypto markets later built the instrument for a different reason and with a different funding rule. This paper gives a single no-arbitrage result that nests both designs: the perpetual price is the present value of a benchmark flow discounted at the funding rate, so the funding rule chooses both the benchmark and the discount. The authors give a random time change representation in which the price is the expected spot at the first event of a clock whose intensity is the funding rate, and use it to show that stochastic volatility moves the basis only through the carry, so a volatility risk premium and not volatility itself can break the peg. They read price discovery as the convergence of a Doob martingale driven by a stochastic approximation, and give a segmented market equilibrium that makes the pre-listing premium structural rather than behavioral. The June 2026 SpaceX pre-IPO market is the first large-scale realization of the idea for an equity claim, and they find that the perpetual consensus forecast the secondary clearing price more accurately than the bookbuilt offer. Facts include the no-arbitrage result, the random time change representation, the finding that stochastic volatility moves the basis only through carry, the segmented market equilibrium, and the forecast comparison in the SpaceX market. Author views include interpreting the pre-listing premium as structural rather than behavioral and reading price discovery as Doob martingale convergence.

cards.titleEn: Generative AI Enriches Analyst Reports but Lowers Forecast Accuracy
keyPoints: FACTSET关联报告的信息源数量增加26%，主题覆盖拓宽24%，分析方法增加21%，时效性也提升。
生成式AI带来的信息丰富化并未均匀改善决策质量：在处理需求更高时，分析师相对预测准确率下降。
机器学习基准处理相同可观测输入时准确率未出现类似恶化，指向人类处理约束而非信息质量下降。
使用其他数据供应商的安慰剂检验表明，结果不太可能由平台层面的共同技术趋势驱动。
总体结论：GenAI放松信息获取约束，但使人类注意力成为更重要的瓶颈。
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on the specific event of FACTSET integrating GenAI in 2023, so external validity is limited by platform, sample period, and analyst population. Report richness measures are observable textual features and may not fully capture information value. The association between forecast accuracy decline and processing demands is observational, and the mechanism requires further identification. The absence of deterioration in the machine-learning benchmark does not fully rule out other unobserved confounders.
cards.description: 该研究利用2023年FACTSET集成生成式AI作为外生冲击，检验GenAI如何改变金融分析师的信息生产。新发现是：报告信息源增加26%、主题覆盖拓宽24%、分析方法增多21%且更及时，但预测准确率在处理需求高时反而下降，而机器学习基准未出现类似恶化，表明瓶颈从信息获取转向人类注意力。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative research, the findings suggest that expanding information inputs via generative AI does not automatically improve forecast quality; when building analyst signals or human-AI workflows, one should distinguish information-acquisition constraints from human attention/processing constraints and monitor marginal declines in judgment accuracy under information overload.
keyPointsEn: FACTSET-associated reports show 26% more distinct information sources, 24% broader topical coverage, 21% more analytical methods, and improved timeliness.
The information enrichment from generative AI does not uniformly improve decision quality: relative forecast accuracy declines when processing demands are higher.
A machine-learning benchmark processing the same observable inputs shows no similar accuracy deterioration, pointing to human processing constraints rather than poorer information.
Placebo tests using other data vendors suggest the results are unlikely driven by a common platform-wide technology trend.
Overall conclusion: GenAI relaxes information-acquisition constraints but makes human attention a more important bottleneck.
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化研究而言，该结果提示引入生成式AI扩大信息输入并不自动等于提升预测质量；在构建分析师信号或人机协作流程时，需要区分信息获取约束与人类注意力/处理能力约束，并监测信息过载场景下判断准确率的边际下降。
cards.title: 生成式AI丰富分析师报告但拉低预测准确率
cards.summary: 事实：使用2023年FACTSET集成GenAI作为外生变化，发现相关报告的信息源数量增加26%、主题覆盖拓宽24%、分析方法增加21%，时效性提升；但在分析师信息处理需求较大时，相对预测准确率下降；机器学习基准处理相同可观测输入时未出现同类准确率恶化；使用其他数据供应商的安慰剂检验排除了平台层面共同技术趋势。作者观点：GenAI放松了信息获取约束，同时使人类注意力成为更重要的瓶颈，且这种约束来自人类处理能力而非底层信息质量变差。
cards.limitations: 研究基于FACTSET在2023年集成GenAI这一特定事件，结论的外部有效性受平台、样本期间和分析师群体限制。报告丰富度指标为可观测文本特征，未必完全反映信息价值。预测准确率下降与处理需求的关联属于观察性证据，机制解释仍需进一步识别。机器学习基准未恶化不能完全排除其他未观测混杂因素。
cards.descriptionEn: This study uses the 2023 FACTSET integration of generative AI as an exogenous shock to examine how GenAI reshapes financial analysts' information production. It finds reports with 26% more distinct sources, 24% broader topical coverage, and 21% more analytical methods, plus improved timeliness, yet relative forecast accuracy declines when analysts face greater information-processing demands, while a machine-learning benchmark does not show analogous deterioration, indicating
cards.summaryEn: Facts: Using the 2023 FACTSET GenAI integration as a plausibly exogenous change, the study finds that associated reports feature 26% more distinct information sources, 24% broader topical coverage, and 21% more analytical methods, with improved timeliness; relative forecast accuracy declines when analysts face greater information-processing demands; a machine-learning benchmark processing the same observable inputs shows no analogous accuracy deterioration; placebo tests with other data vendors rule out a common platform-wide technology trend. Authors' view: GenAI relaxes information-acquisition constraints while making human attention a more important bottleneck, and this constraint reflects human processing capacity rather than worse underlying information.

cards.titleEn: SynH-Rank: A Quality-Aware Code Reranking Framework with LLM-Driven Data Synthesis and Hierarchical Ranking
keyPoints: 现有代码检索重排序器主要建模查询与代码的语义相关性，忽视执行速度、内存占用和可维护性等非功能质量。
作者指出质量感知代码检索面临两个挑战：质量标注数据稀缺，以及标准对比学习目标无法捕捉高质量、低质量与不相关代码之间的序关系。
SynH-Rank 采用三级标签方案：高质量相关 > 低质量相关 > 不相关。
框架结合 LLM 驱动的多样数据合成与分层排序训练。
论文引入包含 4,209 对样本的新基准，并提出 Quality Preference Accuracy (QPA) 与 Multi-Condition Accuracy (MCA) 两项指标。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: The available information is only the paper abstract; full experimental settings, baseline details, data synthesis costs, and potential biases are not provided, nor are the exact computation of QPA and MCA and statistical significance. The new benchmark is author-constructed with 4,209 pairs, and its scenario coverage and external validity require independent verification. LLM-synthesized data may introduce distribution bias, and the annotation consistency and transferability of the three-level labels are not described in the input. The reported performance gains should be viewed as results under the authors' experimental conditions and not directly extrapolated to all code search systems or production environments.
cards.description: 针对现有代码检索重排序模型只建模语义相关性、忽略执行速度与内存占用等非功能质量的问题，SynH-Rank 通过 LLM 驱动的数据合成与分层排序训练，显式建模“高质量相关 > 低质量相关 > 不相关”的序关系，并配套新基准与 QPA、MCA 两项指标，提升了质量偏好与多条件泛化能力。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work expands the evaluation objective of code search from semantic relevance alone to non-functional quality dimensions, responding to developers' practical needs for execution efficiency, memory usage, and maintainability. If the method and benchmark are reproducible, they can provide training objectives and evaluation tools for quality-aware code search, helping developers reuse code that satisfies specific constraints more efficiently.
cards.originalTitle: SynH-Rank: Quality-Aware Code Search via Diverse Data Synthesis and Hierarchical Ranking Training
keyPointsEn: Existing code search rerankers mainly model semantic relevance and overlook non-functional qualities such as execution speed, memory usage, and maintainability.

The authors identify two challenges for quality-aware code search: scarcity of quality-annotated data and the inability of standard contrastive learning objectives to capture ordinal relationships among high-quality, low-quality, and irrelevant code.
SynH-Rank employs a three-level labeling scheme: high-quality relevant > low-quality relevant > irrelevant.
The framework combines LLM-driven diverse data synthesis with hierarchical ranking training.
The paper introduces a new benchmark with 4,209 pairs and proposes Quality Preference Accuracy (QPA) and Multi-Condition Accuracy (MCA).
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作将代码检索的评价目标从单一语义相关性扩展到非功能质量维度，回应了开发者对执行效率、内存使用和可维护性等实际需求。若其方法与基准可复现，可为质量感知代码检索提供训练目标和评测工具，有助于开发者更高效地复用满足特定约束的代码。
cards.title: 面向代码检索的质量感知重排序框架SynH-Rank
cards.summary: 事实：论文提出 SynH-Rank，一个质量感知的代码重排序框架，结合大语言模型驱动的多样数据合成与分层排序训练，采用三级标签方案。作者同时构建了一个包含 4,209 对样本的新基准，并提出 Quality Preference Accuracy（QPA）和 Multi-Condition Accuracy（MCA）两项指标。实验报告显示，相比骨干模型 QPA 提升 20.15%，相比仅基于相关性的标准对比训练提升 15.80%，同时改善了传统相关性指标与多条件泛化能力。作者观点：作者认为这些结果表明分层排序训练能有效支持质量感知代码检索，并弥补对比学习二元目标难以区分离线质量序关系的不足。
cards.limitations: 证据边界：现有信息仅来自论文摘要，未提供完整实验设置、基线细节、数据合成成本与潜在偏差分析，也未说明 QPA 与 MCA 的具体计算方式及统计显著性。新基准为作者自建，规模为 4,209 对，其覆盖场景与外部有效性尚需独立验证。LLM 合成数据可能引入分布偏差，三级标签的标注一致性与可迁移性未在输入中说明。论文报告的性能提升应视为作者实验条件下的结果，不宜直接外推到所有代码检索系统或生产环境。
cards.descriptionEn: Existing code search rerankers mainly model semantic relevance and overlook non-functional qualities such as execution speed and memory usage. SynH-Rank addresses this by combining LLM-driven diverse data synthesis with hierarchical ranking training that explicitly models the order high-quality relevant > low-quality relevant > irrelevant, and introduces a new benchmark with QPA and MCA metrics to evaluate quality preference and multi-condition generalization.
cards.summaryEn: Facts: The paper proposes SynH-Rank, a quality-aware code reranking framework that combines LLM-driven diverse data synthesis with hierarchical ranking training using a three-level labeling scheme. The authors also introduce a new benchmark with 4,209 pairs and two metrics: Quality Preference Accuracy (QPA) and Multi-Condition Accuracy (MCA). Reported experiments show a 20.15% improvement in QPA over backbone models and a 15.80% improvement over standard relevance-only contrastive training, while also enhancing traditional relevance metrics and multi-condition generalizability. Authors' view: They argue these results demonstrate that hierarchical ranking training can effectively support quality-aware code search and address the limitation of binary contrastive objectives in capturing quality ordinal relationships.
